methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

actual_scope: Exact arbitrary-positive destination-priced nonunit dirty-fanout tariff: three-row Z/4 demand (2,1,1), with a local-ring arbitrary-row extension, attaining words and all-interleaving lower bound.
scope_change_reason: Explicit donor continuation of the three-dirty-row question in #5045/#5139. Refine to destination-dependent ADD prices c_ij=c_i, first solving (2,1,1) over Z/4, then any row count over commutative local rings with at least one unit demand. General directed-edge tariffs remain open.
bottleneck_link: A structural source-sharing tariff and restoration result; it does not supply a physical caller or alter the selected multiplication exponent.
stop_rule: Prove an exact tariff for the stated price family or produce a counterexample. Bound independent oracle searches to three-row Z/4 fixtures; retain arbitrary directed-edge prices and all-nonunit demands as explicit remaining questions.
evidence: Written arbitrary-row local-ring proof and matching constructions; exact eight-vector Pareto frontier for Z/4 demand (2,1,1); exact Z/6 nonlocal counterexample 24 versus invalid extension 32. Standard-library verifier: 2,011 demand fixtures, 6,033 price instances, 25,179 candidate words, 213,744 formal-column forward/inverse executions, 6,688 literal forward/inverse executions, 16 independent packed-state bidirectional Dijkstra searches, 154,814 settled entries, 15 controls. Finite checks corroborate the proof; no proof-kernel or independent human acceptance is claimed.
